name: Bhakharwadi
description: The story of Bhakharwadi revolves around two families that hail from different cultures living in the same city, Pune as neighbors. Both are competitors in business. The former runs an ancestral shop of bhakharwadi and is a follower of norms and traditions while the latter believes in matching steps with time and promotes fusion food. Both of them have sour relations due to their competitive attitude. But what will happen when the children of these two will fall for each other?

videos.title: Episode 01
videos.overview:
Episode 1: The Orignal Bhakharwadi

----------------------------------------------------------

The Gokhale's have a renowned shop of Bhakharwadi in Pune. Amol's father is the owner of the shop where they have been selling Bhakharwadi's since ages. A marriage proposal has come for Abhishek and the girl's name is Mrignaini. Will Abhishek say yes to it? Stay Tuned

videos.title: A Trip to the Hospital
videos.overview: Anna shouts at Gayatri for letting her beloved puppy, Biscuit, inside the Gokhale household. After hearing Anna’s harsh words, Gayatri falls unconscious and is admitted to the hospital. After awhile, Gayatri regains consciousness and Mahendra is happy to see Gayatri recovering at the hospital. Watch the full episode of Bhakharwadi to find out what happens next.

videos.title: The Original Bhakharwadi
videos.overview: The Gokhales have a renowned shop of bhakharwadi in Pune. Amol's father is the owner of the shop and they have been selling bhakharwadis since ages. A marriage proposal arrives for Abhishek, and the girl's name is Mrignaini. Will Abhishek say yes to it?

videos.title: A Trip to The Hospital
videos.overview: Anna shouts at Gayatri for letting her beloved puppy, Biscuit, inside the Gokhale household. After hearing Anna's harsh words, Gayatri falls unconscious and is admitted to the hospital. After a while, Gayatri regains consciousness and Mahendra is happy to see Gayatri recovering at the hospital. Watch the full episode of Bhakharwadi to find out what happens next.

videos.title: The Competition
videos.overview: Anna gives Prabhakar a lesson about being generous and open-minded. But looking at Anna's method of doing business, Prabhakar thinks that someday someone will come and open a shop next to theirs and ruin their business. When will Gayatri's shop open?

videos.title: All Permits Done!
videos.overview: People at Gokhale house are having dinner when Abhishek presents the savouries given to him by Mahendra's wife. Anna says that Gujarati savouries are not better that Maharashtrian savouries. Meanwhile, Mahendra is very happy that he is ready to launch his store because he has received all his permits. What will happen next?

videos.title: The Thief
videos.overview: After Anna leaves, Urmila is enraged and feels she has been insulted by Anna. Then, Anna wakes up in the middle of the night after hearing a sound. Anna calls his family members and informs them that there is a thief in their house. Before the family members realize what is happening, the thief escapes. The sounds also wake up Mahendra and his family, who decide to check the situation outside. Anna hints that Mahendra and his family members might be the ones who have sneaked into their house. Anna's remark leaves Mahendra shocked. But, who was this thief?

videos.title: Anna Apologises
videos.overview: The morning starts with a chaos when the kids start questioning Anna about who has given the pencil box to them. He takes Abhishek's help to cover his story. Once they start with their breakfast, he first goes to Mahendra's house to apologize for what happened the other night. Will he get Mahendra's forgiveness?

videos.title: The Hundredth Anniversary
videos.overview: Everyone is excited to organize something for the 100th anniversary of the Gokhale Bhakharwadi House. Abhishek receives a call from Vibhavri saying that she wants to attend the function. Anna becomes suspicious of her being on the call, so post the call, he specifically mentions that Vibhavri is not invited. What turn does the story take?

videos.title: Mahendra's Shop Opening
videos.overview: Mahendra and his family visit Vibhavri and her husband for inviting the hero of their film. They end up insulting Anna, not knowing that Anna is Vibhavri's father. What will happen next?

videos.title: The Competition
videos.overview: Mahendra decides to invite Anna for the inauguration of his new shop and requests Anna to sell the first bhakharwadi for them. Anna isn't pleased with the invitation and ridicules Mahendra. Then, Mahendra sees Anna insulting a customer and believes that steadily Anna's customers will turn to his new shop. He will get loyal customers eventually. Watch the full episode to find out what happens next.

videos.title: The Invitation
videos.overview: Mahendra finds out from Jayant that two actors have agreed to come for the inauguration of his shop. Jayant is impressed by the quality of sweets at Mahendra's shop and asks him to be wary of competition from Anna. Then, Vibha informs Jayant that Anna has asked her not to attend the centenary celebrations of the shop. Jayant calls up Anna and informs him that he will attend the centenary celebrations at any cost. Watch the full episode to find out what happens next.

videos.title: Planning
videos.overview: Abhishek is tensed because of the situation in the house. Anna is angry with his wife and is not talking to her. Bharti is worried that Anna will find out Abhishek's plan and everyone is trying to think of a cover up. What will happen?

videos.title: The Plan
videos.overview: Mahendra finds out from Jayant that two actors have agreed to come for the inauguration of his shop. Jayant is impressed by the quality of sweets at Mahendra's shop and asks him to be wary of competition from Anna.

videos.title: Anna Suspects
videos.overview: Where Abhishek speaks with his brother in a secretive language expressing Vibha as a special guest, Anna suspects that something is wrong. Anna calls Prabhakar and asks him about what they have planned. Prabhkar, who is out of the loop has no clue about what's happening. See what happens next?

videos.title: Vibhu Enters The House
videos.overview: The family members have sent Anna to the shop for veneration. Abhishek calls Vibha and her husband inside the house. Mahendra speaks to Anna about his good deeds and mistakenly talks about his son-in-law praising him. Anna rushes towards his house to take care of the matter. What will happen next?

videos.title: The Punishment
videos.overview: Anna is enraged and feels deceived by his own family members. Anna announces that he will punish himself, this makes Vibha come out of hiding. Amidst the tension, Biscuit goes missing. Gayatri loses consciousness. Mahendra arrives with Urmila to check on his daughter. Watch the full episode to find out what happens next.

videos.title: Anna's Class
videos.overview: After all the chaos, Mahendra's daughter apologizes for the mishap. Jyotsna asks Abhishek to go look for Biscuit and also asks Anna to get inside the room, so that she can scold him for what happened. Anna is scared of getting in the room with Jyotsna. What will Anna do?

videos.title: Still Looking For Biscuit
videos.overview: After Jyotsna scolds Anna for what happened, Anna confides in her by telling her that he was hurt by what happened. Abhishek and Amol are still looking out for Biscuit. Anna apologizes to Mahendra and his wife.

videos.title: Biscuit is Found
videos.overview: Abhishek has found Biscuit and in order to retrieve him, he breaks into the house where Biscuit is stuck. When he is trying to break into the house, the owner of the house returns. He thrashes Abhishek thinking that he is a robber. Mahendra and Urmila inform Anna about what has happened to Abhishek.

videos.title: The Invitation
videos.overview: Gayatri is asked by her parents to not think about her and Abhishek's marriage. Abhishek returns home and Anna takes care of him. Anna is enraged seeing Abhishek's injuries and treats his injuries. Anna is in tears thinking about what will happen to Amol. The family members assure that they will take care of Amol. Then, Anna is invited for dinner by Mahendra and his wife. He accepts the invitation but on one condition. What is the condition?

videos.title: The Menu
videos.overview: The debate over the origin of bhakharwadi leads to an argument between Mahendra and Anna. In the midst of the argument, the feast nearly ends up getting cancelled. Anna controls his sentiments and decides not to cancel the feast. Mahendra has big plans for the feast and prepares a detailed menu. Will the feast resolve differences between the two families?

videos.title: The Best In Town
videos.overview: Mahendra and his wife head to Anna's bhakharwadi shop. Meanwhile, at Anna's home, the debacle to choose the perfect sweet continues. Mahendra and his wife just can't stop their conversation over Anna. Watch the full episode!

videos.title: Where's The Food
videos.overview: Mahendra and Urmila decide to order food but things don't go according to their plan, as the food order gets cancelled. Left with no choice, Mahendra decides to get the food himself from a restaurant. Urmila arrives at Anna's house to keep the family members busy while Mahendra gets the food. Will Mahendra and Urmila succeed in their plan?

videos.title: The Better Cuisine
videos.overview: Mahendra and Urmila are on their way to pick up the food but an accident leads to the food getting spilled on the road. Anna and his family members find out that Mahendra tried ordering food online and failed. Anna comes up with a plan and asks Mahendra to prepare Maharashtrian cuisine, while he and his family members will prepare Gujarati cuisine. Mahendra is fired up and suggests that they should also hold a bhakharwadi competition. Watch the full episode to find out who wins.

videos.title: Bhakharwadi Competition
videos.overview: Amol is sent to Mahendra and Urmila's house to distract the couple while they are busy making the dishes. Mahendra decides to use Amol to his advantage and asks him to take Biscuit to Anna. Then, Anna arrives at Mahendra's house to find out Mahendra and Urmila's progress. Between Anna and Mahendra, who will win the competition?

videos.title: Dinner is Served
videos.overview: Anna apologizes to Mahendra and Urmila for inadvertently misguiding them. Then, Mahendra and Anna's family members gather for the dinner and the food gets served. The family members decide to engage in some impromptu shayari competition. Meanwhile, Pendse is plans to teach a lesson to Anna and arrives at his bhakharwadi shop.

videos.title: The Secret Ballot
videos.overview: Both families have gathered together for a secret ballot voting for choosing the best bhakharwadi. Mahendra requests everyone to be unbiased and vote for the best bhakharwadi. Once the voting is done, Anna gets a setback. What will happen?

videos.title: The Notice
videos.overview: Gayatri presents a gift to Abhishek for helping her find Biscuit. Urmila invites Anna and his family to have a sip of a herbal drink. Anna mistakes the herbal drink to be wine and a grand confusion follows. Later, Mahendra and Urmila find a notice written outside Anna's bhakharwadi shop. What is the notice about?

videos.title: The Lease
videos.overview: Mahendra and Urmila show that they are good neighbours and alert Anna and his family members about the notice. Anna is shocked to hear about the lease agreement coming to an end. Mahendra informs Anna that he has just one day to renew the agreement and if he fails to do it, his shop will be closed forever. Watch the full episode to find out what happens next.

videos.title: Mahendra's Plan
videos.overview: Anna is in a state of shock hearing about the notice from Mahendra. While Mahendra is trying to pacify Anna, Urmila is consoling Anna's family members. Mahendra offers a solution to Anna and asks him to hand over the ownership of the shop to him. Will Anna sell his famous shop to Mahendra in order to save it?

videos.title: Loss Of Livelihood
videos.overview: Anna and the whole family are devastated about loosing the shop to Mahendra. Everyone in the family jokes around to make Anna and everyone else feel better. After Mahendra gets the signed documents he then comes with a new plan. What is in his mind,  to find out more.

videos.title: The Reassurance
videos.overview: Urmila reassures Anna that his shop will be returned to him. Anna and his family express their gratitude and tell Urmila that they are forever grateful for her help. Meanwhile, Mahendra sit's down at the shop and starts selling bhakharwadi. Mahendra secretly shares his plan with Urmila about their next course of action. What is Mahendra planning?

videos.title: A Planned Agreement
videos.overview: Pendse comes to the shop in order to break it down due to the lease renewal clause he had with Anna. Mahendra enters the scene and tells Pendse that he cannot get the shop as Anna had already sold it to him, causing anger and disappointment for Pendse.

videos.title: Amol Drives Everyone Crazy
videos.overview: Amol is working at the shop while a customer comes to get some bhakharwadi and gives him 2kgs when he had only asked for one. Amol denies and starts arguing with Mahendra and the customer. Meanwhile, Anna is curious about what is going on at the shop and peeps in to have a look.

videos.title: Mahendra is Gone
videos.overview: Mahendra locks the store with another lock and he is missing. Anna is freaking out about the shop and his whereabouts. Everyone is thinking that he has fled to London and he must be sitting somewhere and sipping tea.

videos.title: Mahendra Gave Surprise to Anna
videos.overview: Anna was very scared whether he will get his shop back or not, and eagerly waiting for the Mahendra's call. Suddenly Mahendra calls Anna to reveal the truth. What was the truth, and how does Anna deal with that truth? To know more keep watching Bhakharwadi.

videos.title: Mahendra's Moustache Waxed Off
videos.overview: Mahendra and his family plan to record Pendse and catch him live. For that, they come up with a plan of dressing up as dancers and catching Pendse. Will they be able to make the plan work?

videos.title: Happy Times
videos.overview: After the lease for Anna's shop has been renewed everyone is in a joyous mode. Anna thanks Mahendra and Urmila for their efforts. Keshav and Prabhakar play a small prank with Anna.

videos.title: Anna's Sentiments
videos.overview: Anna is playing around with the kids in the house when suddenly he sits down next to Jyotsna and reminisces his childhood with his younger brother, as Mahendra addressed Anna as a brother.

videos.title: Bedroom Talks
videos.overview: Urmila starts talking about whatever happened in their bedroom in front of Gayatri. Mahendra gets shy and asks her not to talk all this when Gayatri is around. Urmila wants to know about Gayatri's feelings.

videos.title: Anna Bhai Got Angry
videos.overview: Anna got angry when someone told him to remove his moustache. Even Mahendra pressurizes Anna bhai to remove his moustache. To know more watch this episode.

videos.title: Anna Shaves His Moustache
videos.overview: Anna is disturbed because of Urmila's statement, so is Urmila. Urmila hands a sorry card to Abhishek, apologizing for the conflict and the comment she made. However, Anna shaves his moustache even before receiving the card.

videos.title: Anna Doubts His Customers
videos.overview: Anna takes suggestions from the men in his house to prepare for his disguise. While at his shop, he warns everyone to be careful while dealing with the customers as Mahendra might disguise and come to visit his shop. They doubt all their customers and get into trouble.

videos.title: Anna and Mahendra's Doppelgangers
videos.overview: Anna misbehaves with one of his female customers thinking Mahendra has come to his shop dressed as a woman. Urmila and Mahendra take a school going kid to Anna and get into trouble.

videos.title: Fancy Dress Competition
videos.overview: Bharti and Amol practice for the fancy dress competition. Seeing Amol act like a famous cricketer, Anna asks him to back off. Mahendra and Urmila are excited and prepare for the competition.

videos.title: Posters!
videos.overview: After the plan of the fancy dress competition is on, Urmila and Mahendra have taken the initiative of pasting the posters all over Mahadev Pet. Have a look at the traditional Anna and Urmila face-off.

videos.title: Vip Trains Amol
videos.overview: Abhishek is taken aback when Gayatri comes too close to him. VIP trains Amol to act like various celebrities while his family sits and enjoys themselves.

videos.title: Amusing Participants
videos.overview: The day of the fancy dress competition finally arrives. The participants amuse the audience with their creative performances. Anna gives away his character of Baburao to Keshav and takes up another character.

videos.title: Few Questions For Yamraj
videos.overview: Bhakarwadi family is enjoying the fancy dress competition where everyone is coming on stage dressed as an interesting character. Anna decides to play Yamraj's character. He asks Mahindra and Gayatri to ask him certain questions during his skit. Everything goes wrong for him when Gayatri starts asking him out of syllabus questions.

videos.title: Inauguration Of Mahendra's Shop
videos.overview: Anna gets emotional on the occasion of Jayant's shop inauguration when he meets actress Shaila Anand and is reminded by her about the childhood days of her as well as his daughters. Later Anna decides to feed bhakharwadi to the first customer of Jayant's shop with his own hands.

videos.title: Mahendra's Shop In Problem
videos.overview: On the very first day of Mahendra's shop, no customers come to them, which intensifies the situation and makes Mahendra panic. On the other hand, Anna keeps his shop closed so that Mahendra's shop could get some customers.

videos.title: Mahendra Wishes to Go to Super Dancer
videos.overview: Mahendra plans of going to the Super Dancer show along with his wife, Anna, and Anna's wife. Immediately his wife starts dreaming of their presence in the show. Later Mahendra gets tensed because of no sales at the sweet shop.

videos.title: Mahendra Plans to Sponsor an Event
videos.overview: To popularize his shop, Mahendra decides to sponsor a grand dance event. He also asks Anna to help him with this event. But Jayant goes against Anna, as he is angry with Anna for not accepting his own daughter's marriage.

videos.title: Anna Doubts Mahendra
videos.overview: Upon listening to Prabhakar, Anna doubts Mahendra for selling his shop's sweets and starts scolding them without any reason. Later Mahendra and his wife prove that the sweets were made by them.

videos.title: The Astrologer's Prediction
videos.overview: A random astrologer comes to Anna's house and claims he knows face reading. Anna trusts and asks him about Mahendra. The astrologer predicts that Mahendra will ruin his life in the near future.

videos.title: Loud Music
videos.overview: Anna tells Abhishek that he would find the best bride for him. Anna shouts at Urmila and Mahendra for playing loud music late at the night. Anna has his family buy the shoes so that they can start their dance practice.

videos.title: Anna Meets Prajakta
videos.overview: Prajakta is in her dance class. Anna arrives with his wife to get dancing classes from Prajakta and both get very happy upon meeting each other. Prajakta starts discussing her childhood memories.

videos.title: Prajakta Confesses Her Love
videos.overview: Gayatri informs Abhishek about Prajakta's feelings towards him and gets emotional at the same time. On the other hand, Anna continues his preparation for the Super Dancer show.

videos.title: Anna's Reports Comes Normal
videos.overview: As known previously, Anna is ill but the reports given by the doctor appear normal. Everyone becomes happy after knowing the results. But Anna reminds himself of his daughter and gets sad.

videos.title: On The Competition Day
videos.overview: Finally, the day came for which everyone was excited. All arrived at the competition and start performing. Gayatri has an emotional breakdown after knowing about Abhishek and Prajakta's dance.

videos.title: And The Winner Is…
videos.overview: The performance of Vibha and Anna is pending. Mahendra and Urmila tell Abhishek to take care of their performance. Anna and Vibha both get emotional during their dance and finally, it's time to declare the winner.

videos.title: Anna's Treatment Underway
videos.overview: The ladies are worried about Anna's well-being and they plan not to let anything remind him about his leg. Gayatri assures her parents that she is fine after her mother asks her why she was crying late at night. Watch this episode to find out more.

videos.title: A Customer Returns
videos.overview: Mahendra has called news channels to cover the second phase of his bhakharwadi tasting session, where people who have tasted bhakharwadi from his shop, will give their reviews on TV. A customer comes back to Anna's shop to return the bhakharwadi that he had brought from his shop because it was tasteless.

videos.title: Blooming Business
videos.overview: Mahendra and Urmila are celebrating because of the sales at their shop on that day. The ladies are impressed with Gayatri and talk so many good things about her. Gayatri gets a surprise visit from Abhishek. Watch this episode to find out more.

videos.title: Lovelorn Heart
videos.overview: Gayatri is still confused in her heart and her mother tries to make her understand that she must fight for love. She tries to be the matchmaker for Abhishek and Prajakta. Will her love for Abhishek remain unrequited? To find out more watch this episode.

videos.title: Gayatri's Confession
videos.overview: Anna is busy coupling up Abhishek and Prajakta. Gayatri's parents are once again arguing with each other. Abhishek is trying to sneak out of his house to go meet Gayatri and talk to her about their situation. Watch this episode to see what happens.

videos.title: In His Heart
videos.overview: In order to know what is really in his heart, Gayatri tells Abhishek to close his eyes and imagine he is alone on an island. Whoever comes to him on that island is the person who is really in his heart. Unexpectedly it is Anna who arrives on his imaginary island. Watch this hilarious episode.

videos.title: Keeping Secrets
videos.overview: Gayatri and Abhishek's relatives get involved in their relationship. Keshav describes Gayatri as a Gujarati in a demeaning way, to which Gayatri's parents respond. Meanwhile, there are strange incidents happening with people at Anna's home. Find out more.

videos.title: Abhishek's Hesitation
videos.overview: As Abhishek is about to tell Anna something, Abhishek hesitates and tells him that he will say it to him in the morning instead, as he does not want to lie to him again. Abhishek, however, tells him that he wants to talk to him about Prajakta's matter. How will Anna receive this news?

videos.title: Open Window
videos.overview: Anna is still eavesdropping on the conversation between Urmila and Mahendra. In his deep sleep, Abhishek is dreaming about the mysterious girl on the boat but is once again interrupted. Anna and the couple next door get into a silly argument when they notice each other through their window. .

videos.title: The Proposal
videos.overview: Anna talks to himself about why is he thinking about Gayatri when Prajakta's father is coming to talk regarding their marriage. Mahendra and Anna couldn't speak to each other about Gayatri and Abhishek's marriage.

videos.title: Time is Running Out
videos.overview: Abhishek proposes his true love for Gayatri. Keshav is revealed to be the mastermind behind creating discord between Anna and Mahendra. As Abhishek rushes back home, there is a surprise visit from Prajakta and her father. Find out what happens next.

videos.title: New Beginning
videos.overview: Urmila and Mahendra are celebrating the news of Gayatri and Abhishek becoming a couple. The young couple is at the beginning of their relationship and they are talking lovingly with each other. Will this happiness last for them?

videos.title: Biscuit is Unwell
videos.overview: Anna scolds Prabhakar because Kakal died after eating a bhakarwadi. Mahendra and Urmila get paranoid over their dog, Biscuit, behaving weirdly. Anna calls Mahendra and they end up having a hilarious misunderstanding in their conversation. Watch what happens.

videos.title: The Missing Bangles
videos.overview: The box of bangles which is given as a gift to Urmila is found to be empty. Meanwhile, Anna and Mahendra are busy with seeking a blessed date for Abhishek and they run into some problems with the date. The ladies get busy searching for the missing bangles.

videos.title: Anna and Mahendra's Action
videos.overview: Anna and Mahendra's groups are busy calling people with recently deceased family members or fathers so that they will be able to sell their bhakharwadi to the families. Will they find success? Tune into this hilarious episode.

videos.title: Jyotsana vs Anna
videos.overview: Jyotsana is angry at Anna for taking up the whole house creating chaos to find the bangle which is missing before the engagement. But Anna cannot ignore this as the ghost has frightened Anna.

videos.title: Anna Creates Trouble
videos.overview: Anna and Mahendra try finding the person's house whose death happened due to the intake of unhealthy sweets, but mistakenly enter a wrong person's house and create unnecessary trouble. But, fortunately, they come out safe.

videos.title: The List Of Names
videos.overview: The families on both sides are busy listing out the names for the upcoming wedding. Mahendra and Urmila are arguing over a special guest from Urmila's side of the family, who Mahendra wants to 'especially' invite. Watch to know what happens.

videos.title: Mahendra and Urmila's Heart Attack Drama
videos.overview: Urmila is berating Mahendra for not standing up to Anna. They plan to create some drama, involving a heart attack, to change Anna's mind. Find out what they are up to.

videos.title: Mahendra's Last Wish
videos.overview: Mahendra and Urmila's act of a fake heart attack is nearly jeopardized when they forget that their daughter is a doctor. Mahendra takes this opportunity and asks Anna to promise to hire a Gujarati caterer. Watch what happens next.

videos.title: Mahendra and Urmila Reminisce Their Past
videos.overview: Urmila compares Anna with a circus ringmaster. Urmila and Mahendra reminisce about their past and talk about how they were before getting married. Mahendra gives tips to Gayatri about how she should behave when she goes to her in-law's house.

videos.title: Abhishek's Plan
videos.overview: Mandaar is determined to not let Abhishek meet Gayatri, but even after being very vigilant, Mandaar fails. Abhishek comes in an old man's avatar and asks for help from Gayatri and Mandaar unknowingly lets her help him.

videos.title: Mahendra is In Trouble
videos.overview: Komila enters Mahendra's life and creates problems for him. Rocky tells Urmila that the clients have liked her pictures and they want her to be the actress in their ad film. When Urmila comes looking for Mahendra, he panics because Komila is still with him.

videos.title: Mahendra Seeks Anna's Help
videos.overview: Amol spills the beans on Mahendra's secret about Komila. When Urmila gets to know that Komila was hiding in her house she gets angry. Mahendra seeks Anna's help because Urmila is angry with him.

videos.title: Mahendra's Crisis
videos.overview: Mahendra is seen shivering after coming out from the freezer and Anna helps to cover him with a blanket. Gayatri gives him a concoction to warm up his body while Mahendra is busy cracking jokes with Prabhakar.

videos.title: Engagement Announcement
videos.overview: Mahendra and Anna fight because Anna doesn't let Mahendra tell anyone that they got the place for free because of him. Kalpesh and Prabhakar fight with each other because both of them want to make the announcement of the engagement.

videos.title: Gayatri's Ring Ceremony
videos.overview: Everyone from the two families gets themselves busy for the ring ceremony of Gayatri. In the ceremony itself, Anna forgives his elder daughter and accepts her but not his son-in-law, Jayant.

videos.title: Love Letters
videos.overview: Vahini discusses her pre-wedding events with Gayatri and makes her aware of how things change after marriage. She also makes her read the letters she had shared with her husband. To know more, watch this episode.

videos.title: Anna Gets Angry
videos.overview: Bharati comes to Anna's shop, and he gets angry because she comes at the wrong time and is argues with him for no reason. Mahendra offers free umbrellas with his bhakarwadi to his customers. Bharti borrows curd from Urmila.

videos.title: Free Umbrella
videos.overview: Mahendra sells bhakharwadi with a new scheme of free umbrellas, which makes Anna a little angry but he still manages the same well. Anna scolds a customer and sends him off as he asked for some free item with bhakharwadi.

videos.title: Comedy Of Errors
videos.overview: Today's episode begins with misunderstandings amongst the womenfolk. Meanwhile, Anna smartly saves Mahendra from a public outburst at his shop. Mahendra peacefully obliges. See what happens in this episode.

videos.title: Urmila Thakkar is Dead
videos.overview: After receiving a fatal head injury from a constructional dysfunction, Urmila is declared dead by the doctors. Tune in to see what happens.

videos.title: Mahendra Becomes Homeless
videos.overview: Amol wrongly informs everyone that Urmila is dead. After seeing Urmila alive, Mahendra is content but then he gets to know that they have become homeless. Anna is reluctant to let them stay in his house. Keep watching to know!

videos.title: Anna Won't Compromise
videos.overview: Anna is afraid of Biscuit and opposes Jyotsna's decision of inviting Mahendra's family to their home. Meanwhile, Mahendra gets trapped in an uncanny place in the hospital. Keep watching to know more.

videos.title: Neighbours Become Guests
videos.overview: Jyotsna had invited Urmila to her home without Anna's knowledge. Anna, who is initially reluctant, approves their stay after a series of dialogues, when finally Mahendra interferes.

videos.title: The Hospitable Maharashtrians
videos.overview: Anna and his family welcome Mahendra's family to their house. Anna cordially lets them know the rules of the house, while Urmila takes too long in the one-and-only bathroom of the house. How will Anna react?

videos.title: Keshav's Plan
videos.overview: Anna is fed up with the guests in his house. Meanwhile, Keshav and Prabhakar plan to scare Mahendra.

videos.title: Mahendra is Scared
videos.overview: Mahendra's suspicion turns into confirmation when he sees something unnatural in his room. Meanwhile, Abhishek tries to spend some time with his fiancee Gayatri.

videos.title: Mahendra and Anna are Worried
videos.overview: Mahendra and Anna are worried because Kalpesh comes unannounced with his whole family at their doorstep. Abhishek is hiding in a closet, and when Gayatri asks him to come out, he denies her. Keep watching this episode to know more.

videos.title: Anna is Irritated
videos.overview: Seeing the problems, Gujaratis are creating in his house, Anna is both- irritated and furious. Meanwhile, Abhishek and Gayatri are still struggling to spend some time.

videos.title: Keshav has an Idea
videos.overview: Amid the hustle in Anna's house, Keshav plans to get Mahendra out of the house. He plans to make Abhishek meet Gayatri in a private place. Anna somehow gets to know this.

videos.title: The Midnight Party
videos.overview: Keshav organizes a party for Abhishek and Gayatri at midnight and on the other hand, he informs Anna and others about it. Now, everybody is trying to look for the couple.

videos.title: Mahendra's House is Repaired
videos.overview: Amid the clashes of both the families over newspapers, toilets, and everything else, Gayatri gives her parents good news that their house is now repaired. Meanwhile, Anna is still worried.

videos.title: Expensive Gifts
videos.overview: Urmilla brags about the cost of the sarees in front of a customer. Anna comes to give good news to his family but when everyone makes fun of his behaviour, he gets angry. Gayatri asks Urmilla to not gift such expensive sarees to her in-laws. Tune into this episode.

videos.title: Urmila vs Anna
videos.overview: Urmila suggests Anna that his image will be ruined if he publishes his business in the way he wants. Anna doesn't like it and he gets involved in an argument with Urmila.

videos.title: Anna's Fasting
videos.overview: Mahendra convinces Urmila to get ready for the marriage and even promises her that the marriage will be according to her wish. Later, all the members of Anna's family try breaking his fast but fail, whereas Urmila succeeds at once.

videos.title: Pre-wedding Drama
videos.overview: Urmila and Gayatri invite a group of singers and musicians. They perform both, Gujarati and Marathi folk dance. Urmila gets emotional about her daughter's marriage while Mahendra and Keshav get ready for the celebration.

videos.title: Urmila is Angry
videos.overview: Urmila gets to know that the designer she had hired is one of her old enemies, Komila. She is furious and warns her to stay away from Mahendra.

videos.title: Mahendra's Mischiefs
videos.overview: Urmila is worried about the whereabouts of Mahendra while Mahendra is roaming around enacting various characters. Mahendra disguises himself as a milkman and tries to meet Anna.

videos.title: Anna Wont Rest
videos.overview: Mahendra tells Anna to rest for some time but Anna is continuously working for the upcoming wedding ceremony. Anna tells Mahendra that he has to match with the bridal party's expenses and so he is working hard.

videos.title: Anna to Act
videos.overview: A director approaches Urmila to act in an ad. He also wants a character in his ad that resembles Anna. Urmila and Mahendra convince Anna to act in the ad. Anna hesitatingly agrees.

videos.title: Anna Argues With The Director
videos.overview: Anna argues with the director and tells him that if he had to do everything then why did he bother to call them for the acting. Director gets irritated because Anna doesn't understand his directions. Keep watching to see what happens.

videos.title: Urmila is Envious
videos.overview: Urmila sees Mahendra with Komila and is enraged. Even Anna fails to pacify her. She is constantly blaming Mahendra now.

videos.title: Marriage Registration Papers
videos.overview: Urmila brings Gayatri along with her to Anna's home for the pre-marriage function, whereas Abhishek plans to get Anna's signature on the marriage registration papers. Abhishek calls Gayatri in the middle of the event and asks her for the same.

videos.title: Gokhale Bandhu's New Branch
videos.overview: Urmila tells Mahendra that Gokhale Bandhu's new branch is going to open in a mall. Mahendra panics when he gets this news. When Mahendra tells Urmila the truth about the new Gokhale Bandhu branch, Urmila tells him that Anna is going to be really angry because of this. Tune in to see what happens now.

videos.title: Anna is Tensed
videos.overview: Anna comes to know from a video clip that one of the branches of his business is running in Ahmedabad. He is disturbed amidst the marriage ceremony. Mahendra then convinces Anna that nothing as such has happened. Will Anna find out the truth?

videos.title: Wedding Takes a Serious Turn
videos.overview: An angry Anna suspects Gayatri and Mahendra's involvement in the establishment of his new branch in Ahmedabad. He questions Gayatri about the same and she confirms her involvement in it.

videos.title: Exchange Of House
videos.overview: Anna's rude decision leaves everything scattered. Gayatri and Abhishek will exchange their house to find a solution to the problem. Even Mahendra and his wife support Abhishek in fulfilling the cause.

videos.title: Gayatri's Emotions
videos.overview: Anna finds out the truth and now has an even worse impression of Mahendra and Abhishek. In such dire times, Gayatri also doesn't help them out but misses Abhishek. Things get more jovial from then on.

videos.title: The Kulfi Story
videos.overview: Gayatri prepares Kulfi for everyone in the family. Anna tells Jyotsana that Gayatri has made Kulfi really well. Gayatri suggests to Anna that they should open a Kulfi stall at their shop as it's a traditional Indian food. Keep watching!

videos.title: Gayatri Takes a Harsh Decision
videos.overview: Abhijeet and his family expect Gayatri to come over to their house for the ceremony of pag phere. This is an occasion everyone is waiting for. However, almost at the last moment, Gayatri takes a rather harsh decision. She decides to get her ceremony done at Bharati bhabhi's house.

videos.title: Family's Love Never Gets Lost
videos.overview: Gayatri celebrates her pag phera ceremony at Bharati bhabhi's place. Gayatri and Abhijeet missed their own families and vice versa. Bharati bhabhi is very happy about the whole thing. What will happen next?

videos.title: Game Makes Work Easy
videos.overview: Gayatri makes a smart move and brings everyone to compete in a cooking game for the morning food at the shop. Anna comes and tastes the food made by everyone and checks if the tastes are all proper. He is satisfied and has high hopes for Gayatri.

videos.title: Abhishek's New Business Plan
videos.overview: Abhishek helps Mahendra to have a huge sale and people are starting to prefer his shop to Anna's shop. Abhishek also shares a hopeful business plan with Mahendra. Bharati bhabhi questions herself.

videos.title: Tradition Versus Change
videos.overview: The wives of the Gokhale family are bonding well. On the other hand, Mahendra's new business plan is slow-paced. It is a battle between Anna's traditions and Mahendra's new-school change.

videos.title: Gayatri Starts The Revolt
videos.overview: Gayatri wakes up the Gokhale family earlier than usual and treats everyone with tea. After being questioned, she sends a message to revolt against Abhishek's evolutionary visions by sticking to her ritualistic ideas. What plan does she have for Abhishek's vision?

videos.title: Intelligent Amol Gokhale
videos.overview: Mahendra and his wife are fed up with their feud with the Gokhales and make an effort to end this. They ask Amol Gokhale to provide intel from the opposition. But, this step doesn't go accordingly.

videos.title: Abhishek's Plan Goes In Vain
videos.overview: Abhishek and Mahendra plan something big for their Dosa Center. Mandar cheekily listens to their conversation and reports back to Anna. Anna has his plans for the opposition. The next day, Police arrive at Gayatri Dosa Center.

videos.title: It's Kulfi Time
videos.overview: Urmila is still pissed at Mahendra for neglecting the license. Meanwhile, Bharti has a craving for kulfi and she convinces Prabhakar to take her to the Kulfi shop. Prabhakar asks his elder brother to join him so that he'll have a backup in case Anna catches them.

videos.title: Anna In a Nutshell
videos.overview: Gayatri and her uncles are caught by Anna at the kulfi shop with Abhishek and his in-laws. Mahendra thinks the time has come when Anna will scold Gayatri. But to their surprise, Gayatri was praised for her effort. Mahendra counters Anna for being a hypocrite.

videos.title: Vibhu is Pregnant
videos.overview: Gayatri and Abhishek are on their trip. On the other hand, Vibhu comes home with great news. She is expecting a child and is here to stay with her family. Urmila ensures that Vibhu's husband, Jayant is also allowed to stay.

videos.title: Urmila Faints
videos.overview: Urmila is still sick because of Jayant's ice cream. The same thing is happening with the others as well. As Urmila faints, her dog comes to the Gokhale house and Anna gets scared of him. Will Anna go and check what is wrong at Mahendra's house?

videos.title: Bharati's Innocence
videos.overview: Bharati and Mahendra decide to bring Abhishek and Gayatri to come closer. They went to buy groceries from a nearby village and thought it would help the cause. But, things didn't work out well for them. Meanwhile, Anna starts to get along with Biscuit pretty well.

videos.title: Preparation For Raksha Bandhan
videos.overview: Bharati along with her husband decides to gift some golden stuff to his sister on Raksha Bandhan. But later, due to some circumstances, they fail to arrange the same, rather her husband pens down a poem for her. On the other side, Abhishek misses his family and his elder sister. Watch to know what happens next?

videos.title: Exchanging Gifts For Raksha Bandhan
videos.overview: While the kids exchange gifts amongst themselves on the occasion of Raksha Bandhan, Amol becomes emotional and misses his wife, Supriya. On the other hand, Mahendra is forced by Urmila to get the Rakhi tied by Komila.

videos.title: Sister's Right
videos.overview: The gifts for the sisters on the occasion of Raksha Bandhan is their right. Urmila asks Anna for something special. On the other hand, Vibhu tries to explain to Abhishek that even if his decision is right, he should try to approach and implement it more subtly.

videos.title: Anna Hides His Pain
videos.overview: Abhishek and Mahendra are going away so that Abhishek can learn new things and open his baking and confectionery shop. He says goodbye and leaves, but Anna gets triggered. He is angry with him, but also sad that he is going. It is the same with Gayatri, but she doesn't show that she is sad. Gayatri is also taking big orders for the shop.

videos.title: Urmila Enjoys The Alone Time
videos.overview: After hearing the news about Bangalore floods and the bridge broke down, everyone gets tensed. Anna asks Gayatri to call Abhishek and Mahendra. She learns about their well-being and informs Anna. The next day, Anna sees Yogesh serving food in Mahendra's shop.

videos.title: Mahendra In Disguise
videos.overview: Abhishek and Mahendra disguise themselves as two Marathi women and enter the town. Urmila spots them, but they trick her into thinking that they have come here to work with Gayatri. Meanwhile, Bharati messes with Anna regarding lunch. Anna makes Bharati pledge about it.

videos.title: Cooking is an Art
videos.overview: Mahendra and Abhishek enter into Anna's house in a different avatar, as lady cooks. Meanwhile, they try to convince the whole house that cooking is correlated to music and dance. Later, they show them how to cook and dance consecutively.

videos.title: Chandramukhi to The Rescue
videos.overview: Bharati's sisters were supposed to come to help Gayatri and Nirmiti with their Mumbai order, but they couldn't come. As an alternative, Anna calls Chandramukhi and her daughter-in-law for the work. Mahendra and Abhishek are in trouble at the hotel, and later, Mahendra might even get caught by Urmila.

videos.title: Chandramukhi Questioned By Jyotsna
videos.overview: Chandramukhi and her daughter-in-law come to Anna's house. Anna is very happy to see them, but Jyotsna is there to keep Anna in line. Anna asks them about their wage and then Jyotsna asks them about their family.

videos.title: Abhishek Pranks Gayatri
videos.overview: Gayatri is spending some time with kids when Abhishek comes disguised as Sulakshana. He succeeds in making Gayatri emotional when he himself cries remembering Raghoba, his imaginary husband. Watch to know!

videos.title: Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: Sulakshana, Chandramukhi, and Anna fight off the goons at the shop. Anna shares that he has cancelled the Dahi Handi ceremony and given that money to charity. At the Gokhale house, the children get to play a treasure hunt game. Amol and the kids win the challenge. Later, Sulakshana and Gayatri have a heart-to-heart conversation.

videos.title: Gayatri is Adamant
videos.overview: Gayatri tells Anna that Abhishek should apologize to her and that she is not at all in a mood to talk to him. Anna agrees with her and tells that Abhishek should repent for his deeds.

videos.title: Anna Loves Chandramukhi's Cooking
videos.overview: As Chandramukhi makes the food, Anna comes to the house, angry at Prabhakar. Bharati plans with Jyotsna to make a face expressing that the food is bad regardless of the taste. However, when Anna tastes the food, he loves it and scolds Bharati.

videos.title: The Test
videos.overview: Chandramukhi and Sulakshana are put to a test by Jyotsna, to check their authenticity. They are taken separately and asked various questions. Both of them are scared, but thankfully, they had prepared themselves. They had practiced all the questions and they both answered the same thing.

videos.title: Abhishek and Mahendra Come Home
videos.overview: Urmila calls Mahendra for the Ganesh Puja. Parallelly, Anna also asks Bharati to call Abhishek for the Ganesh Puja. They both take a leave from being Chandramukhi and Sulakshana. Both of them reach their homes and are ready for being their true selves once again.

videos.title: Maintaining Both Characters
videos.overview: Abhishek and Mahendra are busy maintaining both their characters. They are in a tight spot as Gokhale's family is getting closer to them. Urmila also corners Mahendra, but he manages to escape the problem.

videos.title: Chandramukhi's Narrow Escape
videos.overview: Chandramukhi wears the clothes in the wrong manner and people think that she is a ghost. Later, Mahendra goes to his house for the Ganesh Puja. Chandramukhi was almost about to get caught, but she manages to stay out of trouble.

videos.title: Ganapati Puja
videos.overview: Abhishek arrives for the Ganesh Puja and everyone is happy. Gayatri and Anna wish that everything was fine between them. He leaves and then comes back to talk to Gayatri as Sulakshana. Gayatri bursts out. Later, Urmila almost gets to know the truth about Mahendra and Abhishek.

videos.title: Mahendra Stages Gayatri's Kidnapping
videos.overview: Urmila gets to know the truth about Mahendra and Abhishek. Parallelly, Anna and Gayatri want to meet Abhishek at his college in Bangalore. To avoid that, Mahendra hires a few people to kidnap Gayatri. They kidnap her and everyone is tensed. The kidnappers call Anna and ask for one crore rupees.

videos.title: Finding Gayatri
videos.overview: Anna is going to the police to inform them about Gayatri's kidnapping. Mahendra and Abhishek are tensed because of that. However, Amol makes a mistake and Anna comes back. Mahendra is free of tension. Later, Keshav and gang also check the phone recording and find a lead.

videos.title: Urmila's Tantrums
videos.overview: Urmila gets to know about the staged kidnapping and she overacts in front of Anna. On the other hand, Abhishek's secret is out on the lose. Keshav and gang are on their way to find Gayatri.

videos.title: Terrified Mahendra
videos.overview: While discussing his plans to get back Gayatri, Mahendra gets scared to see Anna arriving. But to his luck, Anna misses listening to what he said. Later, Anna hugs Abhishek and accepts him.

videos.title: Getting Back Gayatri
videos.overview: Mahendra and Abhishek come to Anna and speak about the dream that they had. According to their dream, they go to rescue Gayatri. Mahendra pays the kidnappers and they run away. In the end, Gayatri and Abhishek talk and hug each other.

videos.title: Keshav Gets Caught
videos.overview: Anna is happy that both Abhishek and Gayatri are at home. Anna calls Keshav to ask why haven't they arrived yet. Keshav tells Anna that he is bringing Gayatri with her. Anna catches his lie and says that Gayatri is already at home.

videos.title: Covering Up The Mistake
videos.overview: Mahendra and Urmila together try to cover up the mistake that has been made. They are trying to cover the reason why Chandramukhi's phone was in Mahendra's house. Keshav and the others get closer and closer to the truth.

videos.title: Amol's Innocence
videos.overview: Chandramukhi falls on Anna's lap and Anna tells her not to think negatively. Amol gets a beating in the neighborhood because he wanted to get married. Later, Gayatri and Abhishek play a traditional marriage game. Anna wants to get Amol married to Sulakshana.

videos.title: Keshav's Suspicion
videos.overview: Abhishek is getting into deeper trouble, as Anna and even his mother are fine with getting Amol remarried to Sulakshana. Keshav is growing more and more suspicious about Abhishek and Mahendra.

videos.title: Keshav is Onto The Truth
videos.overview: Keshav follows Abhishek into the hotel where they live. Keshav then tempts the receptionist with money and finds out all the information he needs. Keshav is almost onto the real truth about Abhishek and Mahendra.

videos.title: Abhishek's Gratuity
videos.overview: Keshav is still trying to solve the matter that he doubts on. On the other hand, Abhishek thanks and shows his gratitude for whatever Mahendra has done for him. Later, Abhishek falls in a tight spot.

videos.title: Keshav's Tricks
videos.overview: Keshav tries to get Abhishek exposed but then he is unable to do so. He also uses Amol's emotions for this mission. Keshav is almost confirmed about this fact. He plans something bigger.

videos.title: Mahendra In Trouble
videos.overview: Keshav is ready with his plan and is gradually executing it. Anna recognizes one of Gayatri's kidnappers and learns that Mahendra had done the entire plot. Keshav calls Shinde to the house and is ready to tell the truth. .

videos.title: Mahendra Gets Caught
videos.overview: The truth about Abhishek and Mahendra, disguising themselves as Sulakshan and Chandramukhi comes before everyone. Anna tries to understand the matter but he is hurt. Gayatri is also angry with both of them.

videos.title: Abhishek and Gayatri's Story Rewind
videos.overview: Abhishek makes a call to Gayatri, which she ignores by disconnecting it. But he calls her again. Later, during the conversation, both get nostalgic thinking about their past story. Watch the full episode!

videos.title: Abhishek Makes Anna Emotional
videos.overview: Anna wakes up late in the morning and reaches the shop late as well. Abhishek stays in line at Anna's store to buy some sweets and also offers some new recipes. Anna later scolds Gayatri for smiling at Abhishek.

videos.title: Anna Loses His Patience
videos.overview: While going somewhere, Anna gets crosses paths with Bharati, and upon asking her where she was going, she gets Anna all confused and irritated as well. On the other side, Mahendra becomes sad remembering Gayatri.

videos.title: Mission Munna
videos.overview: Anna and Mahendra join forces to find out who has called Munna to their house. Jyotsna and the others are very happy about Munna's arrival, but Anna is not.

videos.title: Jyotsna Controls Anna
videos.overview: Anna is furious with his family because they all are happy with Munna's arrival. He still wants to know who has invited Munna. Jyotsna controls Anna from bursting out. On the other hand, Mahendra has other plans for the occasion.

videos.title: Komila's Arrival
videos.overview: Gayatri comes to take Abhishek back home so that he can help send Munna Kaka back. As a result, they become friends. On the other hand, Urmila's sister Komila arrives, leaving Urmila angry and annoyed with her presence.

videos.title: Munna is Here
videos.overview: Munna arrives and immediately starts to make people happy. He brings gifts for everyone and even has one for Anna. However, Anna doesn't like him and wants him gone.

videos.title: Love Perfume
videos.overview: Urmila gets a love perfume which makes a person romantic. They want to use it on Abhishek and Gayatri so that they fall for each other. However, things go sideways and it is also used on Mahendra and Anna.

videos.title: Love is In The Air
videos.overview: The love perfume starts working and it makes people lovey-dovey. Anna, Mahendra, and Abhishek are all affected by the love perfume.

videos.title: The Dressing Contest
videos.overview: All the family members along with Anna's friend start a dressing contest, where the dare is to wear kids' dresses and show up. Anna opposes this but fails due to the approval of all.

videos.title: Abhishek's Point Of View
videos.overview: Anna has a break-in at his shop. As his money is stolen, he regrets not putting the high-tech locks like Mahendra. Suddenly, Abhishek comes and returns the money saying that he had taken it. He did it to show that how easy it is to steal the money from their shop. He makes Anna aware.

videos.title: Urmila Sets The Plan
videos.overview: Urmila and Komila discuss their plan for Navratri. They plan to bring Abhishek and Gayatri closer on this occasion. The people are happy with Munna Kaka in the house, but Anna is upset about this fact.

videos.title: Munna Kaka Helps With Business
videos.overview: Munna Kaka, Prabhakar, Keshav, and Anna are at the shop. Munna Kaka comes up with an idea and it works out. On the other hand, he also teaches Keshav a lesson. Later, Anna gets irritated and behaves rude to the customers.

videos.title: Anna is Drunk
videos.overview: Munna Kaka, Prabhakar, Keshav, and Anna are at the shop. Munna Kaka comes up with an idea and it works out. On the other hand, he also teaches Keshav a lesson. Later, Anna gets irritated and behaves rude to the customers.

videos.title: Abhishek Talks to Munna Kaka
videos.overview: Abhishek tells Munna Kaka never to do what he did again. He shouldn't try to drop Anna's self-respect. Abhishek tells him just to help in fulfilling the dreams of the family members. Later, Munna Kaka and Komila have a funny session.

videos.title: Fancy Dress Celebrations
videos.overview: Munna Kaka tells everyone to dress up in various attires and celebrate the Kisaan Divas. Everyone dresses up and is having fun. Anna also takes part in this. Later, Urmila feels jealous of Komila.

videos.title: Prabhakar is Rejected
videos.overview: Prabhakar goes to the music director but he is rejected. Anna makes fun of it and then Urmila calls to share a problem with them. Abhishek and Gayatri have a photo session of their own.

videos.title: Munna Runs Away With Money
videos.overview: Munna Kaka takes the money and runs away. The dangerous money lenders come to collect their money. Anna almost gives away his golden Laxmi idol, but Mahendra stops him. They agree upon returning the money by the next morning.

videos.title: Anna and Munna
videos.overview: Anna is very angry with Mahendra, Urmila, and Abhishek, as they brought Munna Kaka back. Now, Abhishek comes with an issue. The Gokhale land needs to be transferred into Anna's name. However, for this, they need the signature of both Anna and Munna Kaka.

videos.title: Anna's Blessings
videos.overview: Anna tells that whoever will take his blessings first will also receive money from him. He wants Abhishek to get it and that is exactly what happens. It is Abhishek's birthday as well.

videos.title: Abhishek is In a Fix
videos.overview: Abhishek tries numerous times to touch Anna's feet. However, he is unsuccessful in his tries and becomes sad. Anna is rude to him and scolds him. At home, everyone is trying to win the competition of remembering Ram in their daily works.

videos.title: Mixed Feelings On Diwali
videos.overview: Anna scolds Abhishek and tells him to go away. Yogesh is drunk and speaks the truth to Anna. Prabhakar starts crying because of Abhishek. Later Urmila also speaks a few harsh words to Anna. Vibhu is also taken to the hospital.

videos.title: The Property Papers
videos.overview: Yogesh and Munna get to know about the property papers and they come to make a deal with Anna. Yogesh speaks bad about Anna and gets a beating from the women. Anna is very angry and calls for a family meeting.

videos.title: Anna Gives Away His Shop
videos.overview: Munna denies that Anna has given him money for his part of the shop. Anna is suggested to partition the shop or sell it. He would never do such a thing so he gives away the entire shop to Munna Kaka.

videos.title: New Owner Of The Shop
videos.overview: Munna is the new owner of Anna's shop. He is not at all cut for the job and mistreats the customers. His work and ethics are not at all acceptable. Mahendra and Urmila try to help but Anna warns them against pitying him.

videos.title: Family First
videos.overview: Munna Kaka tried to bring further problems to Anna's family. But when it came to family matters, the women stepped up and gave the men an ultimatum. The men eventually chose family over the deal.

videos.title: Gayatri's Business Strategy
videos.overview: Abhishek is instigating Munna Kaka to be competitive about the business. Gayatri tries to drown his business with her brains. Anna's makeshift shop is running successfully. .

videos.title: Munna Confesses The Truth
videos.overview: Police come to the shop and want to arrest Munna Kaka for the murder of Mahendra. Out of tension when poked a little, Munna Kaka speaks the truth about receiving the money for the shop from Anna. Mahendra is still alive and the whole thing was a trick to get Munna speaking. .

videos.title: Urmila is Daydreaming
videos.overview: Urmila is in the shop and is daydreaming. She decides that the best way to get Gayatri and Abhishek together is to ensure that they have a baby as soon as possible. She shares her idea with Mahendra and he is confused about it. .

videos.title: Prabhakar Stops Composing Songs
videos.overview: Prabhakar decides he will not create any more songs and gives up. The entire family tries to get him to make more music. Bharati expresses her attachment to the songs. .

videos.title: Anna's Worries
videos.overview: Anna reaches the scene where Bharati is explaining about her dreams where Abhishek and Gayatri are stuck on a lonely island. Later he gets irritated on Prabhakar because of his habit's.

videos.title: Abhishek Tries to Make Amends
videos.overview: Amol is troubled once again and threatens to jump from the window. Everyone stops him and then later Abhishek speaks to Gayatri and explains to her that he feels her love even through the rough exterior. Abhishek makes efforts to get his relationship back on track. .

videos.title: Prabhakar is Sad
videos.overview: The Literature Club in the society hears the news about Prabhakar giving up songs and comes over. They make fun of Prabhakar and as a result, Prabhakar is sad. Amol goes with Gayatri and family to the temple. .

videos.title: Mahendra and Urmila's Plan
videos.overview: Anna is still trying to get Prabhakar back to writing songs. On the other hand, the priest is tried of handling Amol and hence Amol is sent back home. Mahendra and Urmila have their plan on track and want Gayatri and Abhishek to get closer. .

videos.title: The Impact Of Sweets
videos.overview: Urmila and Mahendra put love potion in the sweets from the puja. They were scared as they mixed those two sweets with the rest of them. However, they ensure that Abhishek and Gayatri get sweets. Anna loses Urmila's dog, Biscuit. .

videos.title: Urmila Tells About The Mishap
videos.overview: Urmila is shy about what happened between her and Mahendra. She tells the story of how her plan backfired on them to Jyotsna, Bharti and Nirmiti. Later Abhishek and Gayatri speak to each other and have a misunderstanding. .

videos.title: Mahendra Solves Prabhakar's Problems
videos.overview: Mahendra, Anna and the others try an ultimate attempt to get Prabhakar back to writing songs. They invite the famous literary idol of the locality to their home and each person poses as a popular poet. The eminent personality praises Prabhakar and he agrees to continue his passion for songs. .

videos.title: Urmila is Expecting a Baby
videos.overview: Urmila and Mahendra go to the doctor and find out that Urmila is pregnant. Urmila reveals the truth to Jyotsna, Bharti and Nirmiti. Later everyone learns of the news and congratulate Mahendra and Urmila. Urmila takes advantage of the situation and asks Anna to bring Gayatri home for a few days. .

videos.title: Mahendra Becomes The Gynaecologist
videos.overview: Gayatri comes at the wrong time and overhears a little bit of her parents conversation. She suspects the honesty behind Urmila's pregnancy and asks to go to a gynaecologist. Urmila and Mahendra draw out a plan and Mahendra poses and comes as Urmila's gynaecologist, Shishupal Sharma. .

videos.title: Urmila Tries to Keep The Secret
videos.overview: Urmila wants to keep her secret and hence she makes a plan along with Mahendra. They execute the plan and fool the people for the time being. However, Urmila is still scared that the truth will unfold before the others. .

videos.title: Anna Almost Gets to Know The Truth
videos.overview: Urmila and Mahendra go to one of their friend who is a gynaecologist for help. Abhishek, Gayatri and Anna get to know about this and reach the doctors office. Somehow, they manage to keep the secret. .

videos.title: Keshav Feels Suspicious
videos.overview: When confronted by Anna and Gayatri, Dr. Narangi informs them that she had asked Urmila to come to her for Sonography considering they are friends from childhood. Gayatri feels suspicious and sets out to find the truth.

videos.title: Abhishek is Curious
videos.overview: Everyone is fooled by Urmila and they celebrate the arrival of a new baby. On the other hand, Abhishek becomes suspicious and starts to inquire about a few things. Keshav almost catches Mahendra in the act but his phone rings at the nick of time. .

videos.title: Race For a Sonography Report
videos.overview: Mahendra is in the race to get a sonography report in time and seeks his friends son Jagdish's help. While he manages to convince him to get a sonography report, he realizes that Jadish is a veterinarian. While Urmila tries to buy him some time by being unconscious, will Mahendra be able to find a way out?

videos.title: Anna Learns The Truth
videos.overview: Anna is excited to see Urmila's sonograph on the computer screen. However, Mahendra and the doctor are shocked beyond belief when they see the sonograph and see a baby in the womb. Is Urmila indeed pregnant?

videos.title: End Of a Tradition
videos.overview: Abhishek, Mahendra and Urmila have made a plan to ensure that Gayatri is back with Abhishek. They asked her to divorce Abhishek if she doesn't want to grace the marriage with her presence. Anna is tensed as nobody in the Gokhale family has ever had a divorce. Will it be the end of a Gokhale tradition? .

videos.title: Twist In The Tale
videos.overview: Anna and Gayatri have the upper hand in the dispute that they have between the families. Urmila and Mahendra are on a hunger strike until they get their daughter back to their home. And they also tell Abhishek to leave their home. Abhishek leaves and is sad. .

videos.title: Urmila's Fast is Broken
videos.overview: Anna and Gayatri go on to break the hunger strike that Urmila and Mahendra had continued. They go on and tell them to break the fast and Anna forces Urmila to eat an apple. After the fast is broken, Anna and Gayatri return as they are happy and successful in their mission. .

videos.title: Jyotsana Shakes Hand With Mahendra
videos.overview: Abhishek comes home to handover the divorce papers and leaves. All the family members get worried while his mother shakes hand with Mahendra to prevent the divorce. By making a situation where Late Tauji communicates with Anna trying to make him understand that their family never had any divorce cases and it should never have one.

videos.title: Anna is Scared
videos.overview: According to the plan, Jyotsna, Mahendra and Urmila are trying to scare Anna. They are trying to bring in a person who looks like Anna's Tauji and scare him. Anna is scared according to the plan but later Amol spoils the thrill. Urmila also puts an ad on the newspapers. .

videos.title: Urmila Takes a Chance
videos.overview: Urmila comes dressed as Tauji and initially, Mahendra and Jyotsna can't recognize her. She looks great in the costume and she just has to make her voice heavier. Prabhakar gets to know the truth and he is made to listen and understand. The plan is on and Anna has a shock coming at him. .

videos.title: Mission to Scare Anna
videos.overview: Urmila, Mahendra and Jyotsna are now busy to carry out the mission. They are trying to scare Anna and to ensure that the divorce is not done. Anna is scared but tries not to believe so. The others in the family are also scared and Amol wants to guard the house at night. .

videos.title: Execution Of The Plan
videos.overview: Mahendra along with wife Urmila as Tauji starts working on their plan but gets caught by Anna's son in the middle. Later Urmila and Mahendra continue into Anna's room to execute the plan and Anna gets scared after seeing Tauji in front of him. How is he going to react? Will Urmila succeed in the plan?

videos.title: Tauji's Ghost Busted
videos.overview: Urmila and Mahendra's plan to scare Anna pretending to be Tauji's ghost goes berserk and the plan fails. Meanwhile, Bharti freaks out seeing Urmila as Tauji's ghost leaving everyone confused. Later, Gayatri is puzzled to find her dads footwear and suspects him for the foul play. What will Mahendra and Urmila answer to Gayatri?

videos.title: Stubborn Anna
videos.overview: Anna Faints in the market and Abhishek reaches to help him but Anna insults and sends him away. Later Abhishek comes to Anna's shop for business and pitches his products and leaves. Anna is lost in himself imagining Tauji everywhere and at night Tauji appears and states his consent.

videos.title: Anna Searches For a Thief
videos.overview: Anna wakes up seeing Tauji in front of him. Tauji says that there should be no divorce in the family. Anna calls everyone to see if it's Tauji or some thief who is trying to fool around. Mahendra and Urmila hide from everyone's notice and escape.

videos.title: Abhishek's Present For Gayatri
videos.overview: Urmila and Mahendra are both trying to escape all the people chasing them. Abhishek arrives at the house to bring a present for Gayatri. This was the day they first met each other, a year back. Abhishek has a letter along with the gift and Gayatri burst into tears on reading it. .

videos.title: Jyotsna Calms The Storm
videos.overview: Mahendra and Urmila escape from the house with the help of Jyotsna. The next morning Jyotsna had to take care of all the people. She had to cover up the mess that Mahendra and Urmila had made the previous night. .

videos.title: Anna's Reaction For Divorce Papers
videos.overview: Prabhakar gets caught dressing up as Tauji by Anna but Jyotsna reaches the scene and makes Anna understand and handles the situation. Looking at the mess Anna says, the decision regarding the divorce will be taken soon. Later, Anna gives a reply to Abhishek's divorce papers.

videos.title: Abhishek Returns Home
videos.overview: Anna tells Abhishek that he is not angry with him. Rather he wanted to correct him and get him on the right track. Anna brings back Abhishek to his home with open arms. There is a small celebration on Abhishek's homecoming. Later, Gayatri and Abhishek have some alone time.

videos.title: The Certification Problem
videos.overview: Mahendra and Urmila have made some major mistakes with Gayatri's marriage certificate. That is the reason they are trying to hide the marriage certificate from Anna. Anna is also hyped to check the certificate. Gayatri almost gets to know the truth from Ujwala. .

videos.title: Abhijeet Tries Finding Gayatri
videos.overview: Anna realises Urmila's mistake in marriage certificate and heads to the registration office and finds mentioned that Gayatri has married Abhijeet. And now Real Abhijeet and his son come finding Gayatri to her house.

videos.title: Abhishek Gets Angry
videos.overview: The son of Abhijeet urges to play cricket with Gayatri's family and all the kids. Abhijeet, Abhishek, and Gayatri also join in to play. At one instance, Abhijeet holds Gayatri while she slips, but Abhishek gets angry and behaves rudely with Abhijeet. Gayatri makes Abhishek apologise to Abhijeet for behaving rudely.

videos.title: Finding Abhijeet
videos.overview: Abhijeet comes and plays cricket with the Gokhale family but none of them knows that it is him that they are looking for. They are all searching for the same person somewhere else. Gayatri gets closer and closer to finding out about Urmila's Tauji chapter. .

videos.title: Getting The Contact Details
videos.overview: Amol has Abhijeet's contact details but he will not share it with the others. Anna tries to be nice and get it but it doesn't make a difference. Later they even go to the court where the mistake had been made in the first place to get Abhijeet's contact information.

videos.title: Krishna's Birthday Party
videos.overview: Abhijeet is at Anna's house and everyone clears the confusion among themselves. Abhijeet and Gayatri both want to sign the NOC for each other and declare their marriage null and void on paper. Krishna has his birthday and Anna wants to celebrate it together.

videos.title: Ethnic Dress Party
videos.overview: Krishna's birthday turns into a much more interesting event at the Gokhale's. At first, there is a competition among Anna, Abhishek and Abhijeet for making the best Bhakharwadi. Thereafter everyone dresses in ethnic attire. There is also a dance programme. .

videos.title: Urmila could be In Trouble
videos.overview: The party is on with Abhijeet also dressing in an ethnic attire. Everyone is happy celebrating when Krishna falls asleep in Gayatri's lap, and calls her mother in his sleep. Later, Anna feels that he has seen his Tauji in the hospital and Mahendra is tensed about it.

videos.title: Abhijeet's Dream
videos.overview: Abhishek hides and comes to meet Gayatri when Abhijeet thinks that he is a thief and punches him. Later Abhijeet has a dream that Gayatri denies to give the NOC as she is too attached to Krishna. Later Abhijeet gets Keshav into trouble.

videos.title: Gayatri's Suspicion
videos.overview: Gayatri gets suspicious about Abhijeet's behaviour about whenever he is on a call he speaks secretly. On the other end, Krishna asks Abhishek and Gayatri to attend his school meeting. Next morning they all go together and Abhijeet arrives as well and slaps a guy who offends Gayatri. Abhishek gets jealous and suspicious.

videos.title: The Homework
videos.overview: Bharti uses pepper spray on Abhijeet by mistake, as she is trying to learn how to use it. This leads up to a massive confusion between Gayatri and Abhishek. As the teacher meets Aa regarding Ujwala's homework, Mahendra and Ujwala start to panic. Meanwhile, Abhijeet's disappearance creates another series of chaos.

videos.title: Abhijeet's Disappearance
videos.overview: Abhijeet has disappeared leaving Krishna in Gayathri's house. Everyone gets curious about the disappearance and they enquire the manager about it and he goes speechless. Aa goes to the police station to register a complaint about the missing. Later, Keshav catch holds Ujwala in finding out the facts about Tauji.

videos.title: In Search Of Abhijit
videos.overview: Tension is rising every second with Abhijit gone for a while, even Aa charges and suspects Mahendra of something fishy. Gayatri tries to squeeze out clues from Krishna about his father but fails. Keshav claims that it was Urmila disguised as someone else in the blanket.

videos.title: Everything is Haywire
videos.overview: Aa and Mahendra decide to go and find Abhijeet where he was last seen. Keshav is still at his investigation along with Mandar to find out who it was under the blanket. Krishna makes it clear for Gayatri and Abhishek that Abhijit disappears often and its not the first time. Meanwhile, Keshav plans to send Mandar at Urmila's place to retrieve clues, somehow he gets locked in a box.

videos.title: Abhijeet Found In Hospital
videos.overview: Tau recollects that he has nephew who lives somewhere in Maharashtra . Keshav finds a Santa Claus costume in Urmila's closet, which Keshav finds hard to digest.

videos.title: Abhijeet is Found
videos.overview: Aa and Mahendra meet Abhijeet and learn that he was looted and beaten at the highway because of which he was unable to contact them.

videos.title: Keshav Enquires About Tau
videos.overview: Aa makes Urmila, Mahendra, and Jyotsna perform for the play. He is impressed watching them improvise on their own. Keshav disguises as an inspector and enquires with Urmila and Mahendra about Tau's get up.

videos.title: Will Aa Know About Mahendra-urmila's Plan?
videos.overview: Abhishek informs Aa about Gayatri's groom exchange idea, Aa informs Mahendra about it and Mahendra is more than happy as he now finds it easy to escape Keshavs suspicious nature. Keshav notices Jyotsna burning something and finds a photo that has only Mahendra , Urmila's pic as Tau in it has burnt and Keshav now gets on the quest to solve the mystery as to why did Jyoytsna burn this pic. Mahendra dreams about Aa and Keshav discovering that Urmila was disguised as tau and decides that we need to erase all the cctv footage memory and plan for the same. Urmila calls Jyotsna to explain the plan but Aa picks up the phone and hears everything.

videos.title: Mahendra's Fear
videos.overview: Aa informs Keshav that Mahendra and Urmila are up to something and are going to come to the house too. Keshav gets going for his trip and makes Aa suspect Mahendra. What is Mahendra & Urmila's fear?

videos.title: Urmila-mahendra's Truth Revealed
videos.overview: Mahendra thinks that the real Tau is Urmila and flirts with him. Aa sees this and immediately shouts at Mahendra. Keshav finds the hard disk of the CCTV footage. Aa watches the CCTV footage with Keshav and gets to know that he was fooled.

videos.title: Faked Tau Revealed
videos.overview: Keshav is showing Aa the CCTV footage, where Aa can clearly see Urmila in Tau's costume. Now, what is Aa's decision after the fake Tau's truth is revealed?

videos.title: Tau Realises His Mistake Of Misunderstanding Gujratis
videos.overview: Keshav asks Jyotsna to leave the house but Aa stops them. Tau realizes that his perspective towards Gujaratis isn't right when he overhears Mahendra-Urmila's conversation.

videos.title: Abhishek-gayatri Plan to Take Aa-jyotsna to Dwarka
videos.overview: Gayatri- Abhishek go to Mahendras shop, they see the brochure of Dwarka & decide to go to Dwarka for their honeymoon. Keshav informs Aa that Abhishek & Gayatri have changed their honeymoon destination and that they were going to Dwarka. Aa is upset. Gayatri calls & convinces Aa. Mahendra convinces Aa to go for an outing to Mahabaleshwar. Bharti breaks this news to Jyotsna and she gets angry as Aa had not told her about it. Later Aa comes to convince Jyotsna and generally irritates her & tells her that he was going with Mahendra to Mahabaleshwar. Abhishek tells Gayatri that Aa has told Jyotsna that he wasn't taking her to Mahabaleshwar. Theres an emotional conversation between the two where Abhishek tells Gayatri that his mom never went out for any outing. Gayatri asks Abhishek why cant we take Jyotsna and Aa to Dwarka.

videos.title: Rasila Wants Her Son Back From Aa
videos.overview: Aa is pulling Jyotsna's leg and says that he would meet Rasila. Jyotsna gets angry. We see Rasila searching for Aa's number in an old telephone diary and says it is time to ask Aa to return her son back.

videos.title: Aa Gets Rasila's Call
videos.overview: Urmila finally manages to convince Jyotsna for Mahabaleshwar trip. Aa receives call from Rasila who asks him for her son. Aa decides to go to Dwarka so that he could avoid Rasila. Keshav tells Prabhakar that he would be going to Dwarka with Aa. Prabhakar says he too want to come but Keshav says that it was a golden opportunity for him to take charge of the shop and that he shouldn't leave it.

videos.title: Family Honeymoon Trip
videos.overview: Everyone has reached Dwarka. All are excited except Aa who is disturbed and worried as Rasila is constantly calling him & asking him about her son.

videos.title: Abhishek is Not Aa's Son
videos.overview: Rasila meets all the three ladies. Aa gets to know that Rasila has come to Dharamshala and he leaves from there with everyone. Rasila chases them and she happens to see Keshav and assumes that Keshav is her son. Aa confesses to Mahendra that he wasn't having any affair with Rasila and that her son was with him. Keshav will take Aa's phone and hears Rasila and he misinterprets that he is Rasila's son.

videos.title: Aa Can't Part With Abhishek
videos.overview: Gayatri and Abhishek want to spend some time together but Jivla is not allowing them and follows them everywhere. Abhishek & Gayatri are irritated. Mahendra is apologetic when he hears the truth & he advises Aa to tell Rasila that he cant part with Abhishek.

videos.title: Aa's Extramarital Affair
videos.overview: Prabhakar gets robbed. An amount of 5 lakhs is swiped from his account. Jyotsna & Urmila suspect that Aa is having an affair. Aa assures Jyotsna that he would reveal the truth to her.

videos.title: Pita Prem
videos.overview: Finally, after a long and twisted turn of events, Rasila meets her son, Abhishek at the temple, but Aa is unhappy. He expresses his reluctance to handover his son to Rasila to Mahendra. Fortunately for him, everyone else also shares his opinions. Therefore, they make a run for if, with Rasila and cops after them.

videos.title: Aa's Rasila Relationship
videos.overview: Mahendra saves Aa and associates his name with Rasila. Rasila brings along an inspector and a chase ensues. Keshav tells everyone that he is an adopted son. Everyone leaves for Sasangir. Aa turns cold when he hears a lion roar while using the washroom.

videos.title: Aa Faces His Rasila Past
videos.overview: The chase ends when Aa and the family reach Sasangir. Rasila also follows them there. Though Aa starts dancing with the Africans to hide from Rasila, she sees this and becomes a part of the group. While dancing both Aa and Rasila come face to face with each other. How will they react?

videos.title: Aa is Exposed
videos.overview: Aa, Rasila, and others dance at the resort, disguised as African dancers. Aa and Rasila both are unaware of each others true identity. When Aa recognizes Rasila and tries to escape, Rasila stops him. A cornered Aa finally tells everyone the truth. Aa and family tell Rasila that Abhishek is her son. Rasila asks Aa to handover Abhishek to her at Dwarkadhish temple the following day. Everyone is taken aback.

videos.title: Aa Gets a 7 Day Deferment
videos.overview: Aa momentarily pacifies Rasila and requests her for a seven days time, before they can come to terms with the parting of his adopted son. The tension doesn't boil down when Rasila returns to Pune since Prabhakar breaks down in front of Nirmiti and Bharti, informing them of his mistake of sharing the OTP. Nirmiti calls Keshav for help.

videos.title: Familys Financial Trouble
videos.overview: While the family is busy arranging 5 lakhs, Ujwala comes up with the visiting card of a man who had offered a huge amount of money in exchange of Biscuit. Kids, in the hope of cracking a deal with the man, are coed when the man refuses to return their dog. On the other hand, Prabhakar's account is credited with 5 lakhs through an unknown source. Gayatri helps Abhishek bond with his mother and consoles Aa.
