videos.title: Rasila Returns Biscuit
videos.overview: Rasila tells everyone that she hails from New Zealand and will take Abhishek and Gayatri with her. Urmila and Mahendra are sad, but Aa reasons that as Abhishek is Rasila's son, he and his wife must go with his mother. Gayatri informs Urmila and Mahendra that Biscuit is missing. Both call the man who had taken him, but he tells them that someone has already taken Biscuit from him. Rasila finally gets Biscuit and returns her to Urmila and Mahendra. Aa praises Rasila's good deed.

videos.title: Abhishek Leaves Aa's House
videos.overview: Aa asks Abhishek and Gayatri to leave at the earliest. He thinks that his children have been deprived of love, so he wishes to train them and shower them with affection. Abhishek is overcome with emotions. The next day Abhishek leaves for Rasila's house along with Gayatri. Rasila welcomes them and does a house warming. At night, Aa tries to cheer himself and others. Meanwhile, Rasila gifts a luxury car to Abhishek and Gayatri.

videos.title: Abhishek Leaves Rasila's Dinner
videos.overview: Abhishek skips Rasila dinner and goes to vaada to help Aa get rid of a rat. Rasila feels betrayed as Aa breaks his promise. Next Day, Keshav visits Rasila's Home. Keshav, Gayatri,  Rasila and Abhishek are going somewhere, when Abhishek notices Aa carrying two heavy bags in his hands.

videos.title: Gayatri Helps Aa
videos.overview: Abhishek wants to help Aa, but he remembers his promise and stays back. Understanding Abhishek's situation, Gayatri goes and helps Aa. Aa reaches home and sees that Amol is doing something absurd. Aa punishe's Amol but he suddenly remembers Abhishek. Meanwhile, the kids overhear Urmila and Mahendras plan. Urmila and Mahendra plot to do something to Aa's passport, so that it will be difficult for him to leave the country. The kids decide to help Aa and they come up with an idea.

videos.title: Kids Steal Abhishek's Passport
videos.overview: The kids plan and steal Abhishek's passport from Aa's drawer. Rasila, on the other hand, asks Aa for Abhishek's passport number. When Aa goes to look for it, he finds it missing. He creates a havoc and lifts the entire house on his head. Jyotsana takes a vow that Aa will not drink of eat in the vaada unless the passport is found. The kids get nervous with the situation. However, Urmila and Mahendra make manage to make Aa eat in their house. They assure the kids that they shouldn't worry, as they will keep feeding Aa and the passport will never be found.

videos.title: Urmila's Vow
videos.overview: Raseela visits Vaada and realises that Aa has lost Abhishek's Passport. She challenges Aa. She tells him that she will get a new passport immediately for Abhishek and after that she take him with her. Aa is upset with his encounter with Raseela. On the other hand, Urmila remembers that her vow is not yet fulfilled. She desires to carry it out before Abhishek and Gayatri leave for New Zealand.  She feels that Abhishek and Gayatri can't live together as a couple unless the vow is fulfilled. Meanwhile, Aa remembers their last years Valentine Celebration.

videos.title: The Police Suspect Abhishek
videos.overview: Aa has tears in his eyes when recollects Abhishek giving him a Valentine's card the previous year. On the other hand, Urmila and Mahendra reach Raseela's house to perform the vow so that Gayatri and Abhishek can live their life as a happy couple. At the same time, Police enters the house to arrest Abhishek under the suspicion of stealing Jyotsna's jewellery.

videos.title: Is Abhishek The Thief?
videos.overview: Jyotsna's jewellery is found in Abhishek's Bag. When they take him to Vaada, it is revealed that Abhishek has stolen his passport along with Jyotsnya's jewellery. Raseela is very disappointed with Abhishek. She goes into a suicidal mood. Aa somehow manages to pacify her. Aa makes Abhishek promise that he will listen to his mother. Later, Gayatri visit Mahadevpeth where she learns that Aa is facing problems because of Prabhakar and Amol.

videos.title: Gayatri Decides to Stay
videos.overview: Gayatri understands Aa, so she decides to stay back with him instead of going to New Zealand with Abhishek. Mahendra is not shocked by this. He supports Gayatri's decision and he tries to convince Urmila to stand by Gayatri. Mahendra feels proud of his daughter Gayatri, for staying back and supporting Aa. On the other hand, Raseela and Abhishek are shocked by Gayatri's decision, they try to change her mind but Gayatri is firm on her decision.

videos.title: Aa Meets With an Accident
videos.overview: The family bid a warm farewell to Abhishek. Later, as soon as Abhishek leaves for the airport, Aa meets with an accident and the news of Aa's accident goes viral. Raseela, Abhishek and Keshav on their way to Mumbai airport make a stop to have lunch where Raseela abruptly makes a decision to return to Pune. Abhishek and Keshav are surprised by Raseela's decision. Raseela visits the hospital along with Abhishek and tells everyone that she saw the news of Anaa's accident on the TV.

videos.title: Aa Goes Blind
videos.overview: Aa has lost his sight due to the accident. Abhishek convinces the kids of the family not to let Aa know that he is back. Later, when Aa returns home, he behaves as if he can see everything. However, Mahendra notices him acting weirdly. He doubts whether Aa can really see. Meanwhile, Jyotsna tells Urmila that she is concerned about her familys financial crisis. Urmila calms her down and says that she has an idea. Later at night, Aa trips over a mousetrap. Anmol shouts and wakes up all. When Abhishek calls out Aa's name, everybody holds their breath. Will Aa realize that Abhishek is back?

videos.title: Gayatri Gets Surprised
videos.overview: Urmila explains to Aa that Prabhakar is talking to him in Abhishek's voice. Therefore next day, Aa calls a man in womans voice, this causes a ruckus in the shop. Mahadev arrives at the shop to handle the situation. Mahadev and Keshav doubt that something is wrong with Aa.  Meanwhile, Urmila takes Jyotsna with her to a certain location. When they both return, they have two large bags of fresh, good quality vegetables. Gayatri is surprised by the vegetables, as their financial crisis is not yet over.

videos.title: What Makes Keshav Suspicious?
videos.overview: Kids and Amol force Aa to play with them. Aa is in a fix, but he somehow persuades everyone to play carrom. Meanwhile, Abhishek accidentally drops in front of Aa, but he immediately removes the fuse of the house. Kids warn Aa about the dark, and Aa immediately starts narrating a story. Soon, Gayatri fixes the fuse. On the other hand, Keshav and Prabhakar finds Aa narrating the story to the kids who are fast asleep. Keshav grows suspicious. What will Keshav do?

videos.title: Keshav Tricks Aa
videos.overview: Mahendra calls Aa to his shop. He then lies to him that he has bought a she-dog as Biscuits companion. Aa asks Mahendra to make the dog bark. Urmila makes sound of barking. Aa then declares that the dog will be a perfect partner for Biscuit. Now Mahendra and Urmila are sure that Aa is unable to see. Mahendra instructs Urmila to keep it a secret. Later, Keshav cheats Aa into getting him sign the power-of-attorney by saying that they are medi-claim paper. He calls someone and discusses the same. However, Mahendra overhears him. What will Mahendra do?

videos.title: Anna Plays Blind
videos.overview: When Aa hears that Abhishek has not gone to New Zealand, he tells everyone that he is not able to see anything.

videos.title: Keshav Sells The Shop
videos.overview: Keshav sells the Gokhale Bandhu shop to Diwan for two crore rupees, while someone secretly records the whole deal.

videos.title: Aa Calls The Police
videos.overview: Aa continues to pretend he's blind, and sees Keshav getting home a bag full of money. Mahendra and Abhishek are after Keshav, trying to snatch the bag from him. Amidst all the confusion, the bag opens and the money falls out. Aa enters the room and sees the money lying on the floor. But, Keshav and gang lie to him, not knowing that he can see it clearly. Later, Aa informs police. What is going on in Aa's mind?

videos.title: Bharti Doubts a Blind Anna
videos.overview: As Mahendra takes away all the money with him, the Police dont find anything in Keshavs bag. Aa feels disturbed but hides his anxiety. The next day, Bharti witnesses Aa doing a few things, which turns her doubtful about his blindness. Later, she also catches him, while he's taking a newspaper from the table. What will Aa explain to Bharti now?

videos.title: Anna Caught Red-handed
videos.overview: Bharti catches Aa red-handed while he's secretly reading a newspaper. Aa confesses the truth to Bharti regarding his fake blindness. He also tells Bharti about his actual mission, which is to expose Mahendra and Abhishek. Bharti supports Aa, and joins his team.

videos.title: Will Anna Reach On Time?
videos.overview: While Aa and Bharti are stuck in the elevator, Deewan reaches to take over Gokhale's shop. Abhishek then calls Mahendra and informs him about the situation. Mahendra immediately rushes. Will Deewan be able to take over Gokhale's shop?

videos.title: Gokhale Bandhu Sold?
videos.overview: Aa and Bharti reach at the nick of time and expose Deewan. Meanwhile, Mahendra explains all the reasons behind this plan. He shows the proof, sorting out the misunderstandings. What will happen next?

videos.title: Who is This Mystery Girl?
videos.overview: Aa and family celebrate Holi together. There, Abhishek and Gayatri challenge each other with a bhakharwadi competition. Later, Abhishek wins the challenge, as a girl comes and buys all the bhakharwadis. Who is this mystery girl?

videos.title: Anna Arrested
videos.overview: Aa makes fun of Mahendra and his bhakarwadi. This hurts Mahendra deeply. Suddenly and out of nowhere, the police arrive and arrest Aa. The police claim that a complaint has been lodged against Aa. The complaint states that a few people have been admitted to hospitals due to food poisoning caused after consuming the bhakarwadi from Aa's shop. Mahendra assures the Gokhale family that he would think of a way out.

videos.title: Mysterious Sage
videos.overview: A sage comes and declares that Aa must face hardships because Sage Khadang Bhushan is upset with him. Bharti starts chanting the sages name in order to save Aa and at the same time, a man named Bhausaheb helps release Aa. Everybody reaches home and the unknown man reveals that he too is a follower of Sage Khadang Bhushan.

videos.title: Anna's Never Ending Troubles
videos.overview: The follower of Sage Khadang Bhushan asks Bharti to recite the mantras of Khadang Bhushan in order to get Aa out of trouble. Bharti chants the mantra and Bhausaheb gets Aa out of jail on bail. On reaching home, they come to know that Bhausaheb is also a follower of Sage Khadang Bhushan. This is something that Aa dislikes.

videos.title: Will Anna Surrender Himself?
videos.overview: When it looks like life has returned to normal, the police inspector informs Aa about another death by his Bhakarwadi. He asks Aa to surrender. Meanwhile, accepting the advice of a Khadang Bhushan follower, Bharti decides to dig out a Khadang Bhushan idol. Later, a post-mortem report mistake comes to light, proving Aa's iocence. By then, the idol is dug out.

videos.title: Is Anna Being Framed?
videos.overview: People confess to Aa that they filed complaints against him because they were asked to do so. Mahendra calls Bhausaheb to find out about Aa's release. Bhausaheb says that he thinks there is some invisible power supporting Aa. When Aa reaches home with the family many people demand that a temple be built in the place where the idol was found. Aa drives them out of the house. But they protest nevertheless.

videos.title: Anna's Concern For Protestants
videos.overview: Aa feels concerned about the people protesting outside his house. They have been there the whole day. But Keshav asks Aa to ignore them. Later in the night, Urmila, Bharati and Gayatri distribute food to the protestants.

videos.title: Bharti's Kindness
videos.overview: Aa appreciates Bhartis kindness towards the protesting people. But in the morning the house is in a mess. Bharti is also busy taking care of the people rather than looking after Aa. Meanwhile, Radha tells Abhishek to meet her without Gayatri's knowledge.

videos.title: Gayatri Refuses Radha's Offer
videos.overview: Bharti is about to prepare lemon water for Aa but when she slices a lemon, the lemon bleeds. And same with other vegetables. Bharti is scared. Nimrit tells Bharti that Bharti is having an illusion and demonstrates cutting a vegetable to prove her statement. Nimrit is stued and confused on seeing the red juice seeping out. On the other hand, the Gokhale family is unable to find a lawyer who can fight Aa's case. Gayatri makes Abhishek call Radha to find out what Radha wants. Abhishek does so and Radha tells him that she wants to meet both Gayatri and Abhishek. Radha meets them and says that she has a way of saving the house but she would like something in return. Gayatri assumes what Radha wants and sends Radha away based on her assumption. Abhishek tells Gayatri that they should have let Radha speak about what she wanted before refusing her offer right away. But Gayatri's assumption is correct and it is later discovered that Radha wants Abhishek in order to save the house.

videos.title: Gayatri Signs The Papers
videos.overview: Gayatri signs the divorce papers in exchange for the house. In the meanwhile, Bharti and Prabhakar join the protestors. Will Aa be at peace with what is going on?

videos.title: Radha and Bhau Set a Trap
videos.overview: Gayatri falls into Radhas trap as she signs the papers. It is revealed that Radha is the daughter of Bhau and she has deceived Gayatri and made her sign the papers to sell the house. Next morning, Mahendra receives a call from the insurance company claiming that the insurance amount had to be transferred to Gayatri's bank account. Mahendra gives them the account number. Little does he know that it was Radha who had called. Radha and Bhau succeed in depositing money into Gayatri's account. Gayatri straight falls into a trap with a false evidence. The following morning, Radha and Bhau reach the house and claim that Gayatri has agreed to sell the house. When Mahendra tells them that they are not authorised to do so, Radha and Bhau threaten to charge the family under deception charges. Aa is furious when Mahendra suggests him to disown Gayatri as thats the only way out of the mess.

videos.title: The Fight Continues
videos.overview: Gokhales and Thakkars, both are living a lie for the sake of Krish, Abhishek and Gayatri's seven-year-old son. However, when Krish is out of the house, both families return to their original self and continue to fight among each other. And one of those fights is about Krish's seventh birthday. Stay tuned to know who wins this fight.

videos.title: The Happiest Student
videos.overview: Gokhales and Thakkars, both feel proud of Krish for receiving the happiest student award, but even then, they can't keep their differences aside. However, the water goes over the bridge when Thakkars accidentally put their wardrobe in front of Gokhales' house. With Krish returning from school at the same time, how will his family avoid the fight? Let's find out in this episode.

videos.title: The Intention
videos.overview: Mahendra visits Anna's room with some hidden intention. Meanwhile not everything is going well at Krish's end. What is Mahendra's secret plan? What is wrong with Krish? This episode will rest all your doubts. Watch now!

videos.title: The Cake Chronicle
videos.overview: Anna and Keshav discuss a plan for Krish's cake cutting. But there is no grain of truth in it. On the other hand, Mahendra and Anna end up challenging each other. Why is a fake cake cutting being planned? What is the challenge all about? Watch this thrilling episode to know more.

videos.title: Many Plans, One Birthday!
videos.overview: Finally it's just a day to Krish's birthday. The birthday boy is excited and so are a lot of other people. Different people make different plans for the cake cutting. Whose plan will succeed? This episode will tell you.

videos.title: Fake Caller
videos.overview: Anna mistakes the caller on the phone and divulges vital information to him. Meanwhile Krishna is nowhere to be found. What does Anna divulge? Where does Krishna go missing? Watch this episode to clear your confusion.

videos.title: Hide and Seek
videos.overview: In the process of finding the whereabouts of Krishna, different teams search in different places. Ultimately Krishna arrives for the cake cutting. He cuts two separate cakes. But as the cake cutting takes place, something unpleasant happens which leaves a bitter taste in Anna's mouth. What happens to cause Anna distress? Let the cake cutting ceremony in this episode reveal to you.

videos.title: Disturbance
videos.overview: Anna has full proof plans of ensuring that Urmila and Mahendra get irritated and disturbed. He stages a solid prank with the help of Prabhakar and Mandar. Meanwhile, Sudhakar encounters a significant crisis in his life and seeks Anna's help. What is Anna's disturbance plan? Will Anna lend help to Sudhakar? Watch all this and more, in this episode.

videos.title: The S Couple
videos.overview: There is a specific reason why Sumeet and Sangeeta decide to visit Anna's house. An important aspect is that their son is a classmate of Krishna and Krishna should be deceived to believe that all is well with his friend's parents. Meanwhile, Bharti's Yoga stunts prove to be too costly for Anna. What is wrong with Sumeet and Sangeeta? What happens when Bharti starts Yoga? Catch the events in this episode.

videos.title: Fight No More
videos.overview: Anna mocks a fight with his family to give Sumeet and Sangeeta an insight into life after divorce. Mahendra and Urmila agree to support Anna in times of crisis. On the other hand, Gokhale and Thakkar start behaving extra sweetly, which raises suspicion in Sumeet and Sangeeta's minds. Keshav and Urmila soon get into an argument totally unaware of Krishna's presence. Just as Prabhakar arrives they start acting normal, but Krishna tells him about their tiff, and Prabhakar warns both Keshav and Urmila. Will Anna be able to prevent the divorce that he is foreseeing? Will Keshav and Urmila be able to sort out their differences? Watch Anna's next move in this episode.

videos.title: Plane Fight
videos.overview: Anna and Urmila and Mahendra have sworn not to fight in front of Sumit and Sangita. So, they, and  come up with an idea to fight using paper planes. However, Sumit and Sangita become suspicious of the change between the two families. Later that day, Anna and Mahendra and Urmila are throwing paper planes at each other. Will they make Sumit and Sangita suspicious? What will happen if Sumit and Sangita catch them fighting? Tune in to find out what happens next.

videos.title: A Misfired Plan
videos.overview: Anna and Mahendra are fighting with each other using paper planes. But Amol uses the very same paper planes to make Krish's school project. Parallelly, Sumit and Sangeeta are suspicious about the paper planes. So, to divert their attention, Urmila tells them that she has thrown all the paper planes in the dustbin. But if Amol has used the paper planes for the school project, will Sangita and Sumit find anything in the dustbin? Tune in to find out how the plan unfolds, in this episode.

videos.title: The Conniving Couple
videos.overview: Sumit and Sangita have a laid a trap for Abhishek and Gayatri. The cunning couple is going to make them both spill the beans and they even take the necessary steps towards actualising their plan. But in the nick of time, the situation is turned around as Anna and Mahendra intervene. What is Sangita and Sumit's plan? How do Anna and Mahendra turn it around? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: The Secret is Guarded
videos.overview: On one hand, everyone is worried that Abhishek and Gayatri might spill the beans due to the truth syrup. And on the other hand, while discussing a solution to this problem, Anna and Urmila get into a heated argument. Not only Sumit and Sangita but even Krish witnesses their spat. How will the families salvage this situation? Will Abhishek and Gayatri reveal the truth to Krish? Watch this and more, only in this episode of Bhakarwadi.

videos.title: Troublemakers are Gone
videos.overview: Chirag bets that Urmila can make Sumit and Sangita leave the house. After Anna's approval, Urmila talks to the couple and they prepare to leave the house. What did Urmila tell Sumit and Sangita? Have they really left the house? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Supreme Happiness
videos.overview: Though Sumit and Sangita planned to leave the house as per Urmila's words, something else is brewing in their minds. They plant a camera in Abhishek and Gayatri's room and plan on showing the footage to the family. However, their plan gets derailed when Krish gets home and the laptop breaks. Does this mean that they will finally exit the house and Urmila will win the bet? Will Urmila convince Krish to stay? See what happens next in this entertaining episode of Bhakharwadi.

videos.title: Uncovering The Truth
videos.overview: Anna has barricaded Krish from meeting Mahendra and Urmila. A curious Krish, wonders why. Mandar receives the instructions to keep an eye on Krish. But little does Mandar know that Krish can easily get his way. He smartly distracts him, so that he can find things out. What happens when Krish gets his hands on the recording? Will the dispute between the families intensify? Tune in to see how Krish deals with the truth and what lies ahead in the fate of both the families.

videos.title: Panic Strikes
videos.overview: Another trouble strikes. Krish finds the recordings and discovers the truth which the families were worried about. Disappointed by what he has found, he locks himself up in the room and refuses to come out. When the members break into the door, they are stunned to see that Krish is missing. Worry trickles down their bones and they begin to scout for Krish everywhere. What happened to Krish? Where did he go? Is he safe? Find out what unfolds next in this episode.

videos.title: Bridging The Gap
videos.overview: Krish had left his house and everyone was extremely concerned about his whereabouts. While some were going helter-skelter looking for him, thoughts of him being kidnapped cropped up as well. But Krish arrives soon and brings along a lawyer with him. He demands separation from both the families. This leaves them speechless. Why did Krish take such a drastic step? What are his intentions behind seeking the separation? Will the families give into his demand? Find out what happens in this episode.

videos.title: The Court is In Session
videos.overview: Krish wants to reunite the families. He uses reverse psychology saying that he wants to separate from both the families. Owing to which, a court is set up in wada, and the two families are pitted against each other to prove their righteousness. A confession surfaces while the court is in session. Will this bridge the gap between the Thakkars and Gokhales? Or will Krish's plan not bear a reward? Watch this entertaining episode to find out what happens.

videos.title: Makeshift Court
videos.overview: The bungalow has been converted into a temporary court and two judges have been appointed to proceed with the case at hand. While one of the judges is a Gujarati, his opponent is a Marathi. What happens as the judges take the case ahead and various witnesses are called upon? Watch this episode to view the courtroom scene.

videos.title: Lack Of Proof
videos.overview: With Urmila backing Anna's innocence, the latter hits a dead end, as he is unable to think of any concrete event, which can be used as a proof against Mahendra. Gayatri further justifies all of Mahendra's deeds, which actually were in Anna's favor. Without any proof, will Mahendra be proven guilty? Watch this episode as Anna struggles to get his points proven.

videos.title: Oblivious Mahendra
videos.overview: Forgetful Mahendra enters the vaada court but appears to be lost about his very purpose of visit. It is then that Mandar steps forward to offer him help. On the other hand, Abhishek is hell bent on proving Gayatri guilty. Is Mahendra really forgetful or is this a purposeful gimmick? Will Abhishek manage to really prove Gayatri guilty? Watch the court proceedings in this episode.

videos.title: Untrue Story
videos.overview: Abhishek's character is at stake if one was to believe what Divyangana narrates. It is obvious that her story is cooked up. What is more surprising is that she is putting up this act on someone's instruction. Who wants to harm Abhishek's reputation? Will Abhishek come out clean? Watch this episode to find out what happens next.

videos.title: Illogical Demand
videos.overview: Krishna expresses a  wish which is rather absurd. He wants a different and new set of parents and grandparents. While everyone is baffled at this unusual demand, Krishna is unwilling to budge from his stand. Is it really Krishna's demand or is someone instigating him.

videos.title: Matchmaking
videos.overview: With Urmila and Mahendra on Abhishek's side and Anna on Gayatri's, they are hunting for suitable matches for both of them. Urmila and Mahendra find a salesgirl, Aishwarya, to be suitable for Abhishek. On the other hand, Anna believes that Aprateem is the perfect partner for Gayatri. But will Aishwarya and Aprateem agree for a fake marriage? Will the elders' trio be able to convince them? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Prospective Partners Go Missing
videos.overview: Aishwarya and Aprateem are missing. No one has any idea about their whereabouts. While the search is on, the results are disappointing thus far. Will they be found and if yes, where? Catch this confusing episode to know the details.

videos.title: False Fiance
videos.overview: Ahishek-Aishwarya and Aprateem-Gayatri make ideal pairs. At least that's what Anna thinks. The truth, however, is not what meets the eyes. Abhishek and Aishwarya are merely pretending to be in love. Is Aprateem too following suit? Why are these people pretending? Who has plotted this play acting? Watch this episode to get to know better.

videos.title: A Surprise Awaited
videos.overview: There is a lot happening in the vaada! While Aprateem confirms to Anna that he will marry Gayatri, Aishwarya takes over Urmila's household work enabling Urmila to have some time for herself. Abhishek, on the other hand, has a surprise planned for Krishna. Watch this episode to find out Abhishek's surprise for Krishna.

videos.title: Gayatri‚äôs Important Decision
videos.overview: Everyone at Anna's place is enjoying a game of 'langadi', where Aprateem and Gayatri bond better. On the other hand, moments of happiness pass between Abhishek and Aishwarya at Mahendra's place. While varied emotions are doing the rounds, Gayatri announces an important decision. What does Gayatri decide? Watch this episode to know more.

videos.title: Twin Marriages
videos.overview: Aprateem weds Gayatri and Abhishek marries Aishwarya. While the two weddings are being solemnised by Anna and Mahendra, Keshav unintentionally spills the beans. He blurts out the truth which makes everyone tipsy. What does Keshav reveal? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Adamant Anna
videos.overview: Anna decides to make Aprateem start the Ganesh Aarti. This news is passed on to Mahendra's house which does not go down well with Abhishek. How will Gayatri and Aishwarya pitch in this situation? Will they ease out the tension or add further to it? Watch the episode dedicated to celebrating Ganesh Chaturthi to know more.

videos.title: Truth Revealed
videos.overview: During Ganesh Chaturthi, Urmila and Jyotsna make up their minds to meet and talk to their children just like good old times. Accordingly, Gayatri and Abhishek meet their respective mothers and share vital information about their marriages. Watch this episode to unfurl all the emotional moments that follow.

videos.title: Mask Off
videos.overview: Aprateem threatens Mahendra, Ujwala and Mandar of dire consequences if they try to alert Anna of his true identity. In such a critical situation, Keshav is the only hope remaining. What does Aprateem threaten Mahendra about? Will Keshav be of any help? Watch this episode to get your answers.

videos.title: The Wrongdoer
videos.overview: Aprateem has held Mahendra, Ujwala, and Mandar as captives in a remote location. Abhishek follows Keshav's mobile phone and tries to locate the spot. As he reaches the place, he finds them tied up. Will he manage to free them? If yes, how? Watch this revealing episode to know all this and more.
